ai_overview.markdown:
Proposing requires `choosing a meaningful location, preparing a short heartfelt speech, and focusing on your partner's personal preferences`.[[1]](https://hunterandsarah.com/how-to-propose-6/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/eluZpkPrQII)[[3]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/proposal-ideas/)

### Key Steps to Plan a Proposal

- **Pick the ring:** Find out your partner's jewelry style by looking at what they already wear or asking a close friend for advice.
- **Choose a location:** Select a spot with personal meaning, such as the place of your first date or a scenic outdoor destination.
- **Decide on privacy:** Think about whether your partner wants an intimate, private moment or a celebration with family and friends.
- **Write a short speech:** Keep what you want to say between 30 seconds and one minute, focusing on your favorite memories and why you love them.
- **Capture the moment:** Hire a professional photographer or set up a hidden camera to record the reaction.[[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DSX3vJFj0qo/)[[2]](https://hunterandsarah.com/how-to-propose-6/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o2o1OKuWVBM)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/eluZpkPrQII)[[5]](https://www.beaverbrooks.co.uk/proposal-guide)[[6]](https://www.vogue.com/article/how-to-propose-like-a-pro)[[7]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EpFOup1Buck)[[8]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DiacxUGDyj8&t=14)[[9]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/RoPcM1wZpns)
